items.text:
I would have loved to leave a positive review as I love the concept of the game, but I can't.

Way too many bugs, that it can brick your save ... if you manage to save or load it of course. Game freezes when trying to save, items disapearing, character teleporting in the void (thus dying), it's too much.

Devs are not as active on discord as they like to advertise.

Charging 20€ for a game in this state is not worth it in my opinion. Hopefully in a few years the game becomes playable and worth its price.
items.text_zh:
我本来很想留下一条好评，因为我喜欢这款游戏的概念，但我做不到。

Bug 太多了，多到能让你的存档报废……如果你能成功保存或加载它的话。游戏在尝试保存时会卡死，物品消失，角色传送到虚空（因而死亡），这太过分了。

开发者在 Discord 上并不像他们喜欢宣传的那样活跃。

在我看来，为一款处于这种状态的游戏收取 20 欧元并不值得。希望几年后这款游戏会变得可玩并值这个价。
